evals.name: csv-export-explicit
evals.prompt: Write acceptance criteria for this feature: users can export their order history as a CSV file from the account page.
evals.expected_output: AC-n Given/When/Then, <=8, failure path, open questions for unstated limits (date range, row cap), out of scope

evals.name: what-does-done-mean
evals.prompt: We're adding a 'save for later' button on the cart page. What does done mean for this one? Our QA keeps asking.
evals.expected_output: Criteria even without the phrase acceptance criteria

evals.name: tester-would-know
evals.prompt: Ticket: 'Make the search box fast and easy to use, with autocomplete suggestions.' How would a tester know when this is finished?
evals.expected_output: No banned words, no invented latency numbers, open questions naming ACs

evals.name: request-with-stated-numbers
evals.prompt: Feature request: lock an account for 15 minutes after 5 failed login attempts, and email the owner when it happens. Give me testable criteria.
evals.expected_output: Uses 15 and 5 as stated; does not invent other numbers; open questions for unstated rules (e.g. reset on success, email wording)

evals.name: large-sprawling-request
evals.prompt: turn this into acceptance criteria pls: admins can invite team members, assign roles, remove members, see an audit log of changes, bulk import from CSV, and set up SSO
evals.expected_output: Capped at eight criteria, rest in out of scope
